sloka: खड्गिनौ दृढ धन्वानौ तिग्म तेजौ महा भुजौ ।भ्रातरौ विवशम् प्राप्तौ कृष्यमाणौ महा बलौ ॥३-६९-३६॥
transliteration: khaḍginau dṛḍha dhanvānau tigma tejau mahā bhujau ।bhrātarau vivaśam prāptau kṛṣyamāṇau mahā balau ॥3-69-36॥

translations.english: The two mighty brothers who wielded swords and strong bows and whose bodies were of fiery splendour became helpless, seized by the hands of Kabandha.
